text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I constructed and executed what I
believed to be
the most effective plan
for victory...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And yet it resulted in failure... Where
did I go
wrong?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I... I don't know how to proceed from
here...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I... I don't know how to proceed from
here...
choice_data_list: We can just think about it together.
Even so, you've just got to keep running!
Even so, you just have to keep on running!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: We can just think about it together.
Even so, you've just got to keep running!
Even so, you just have to keep on running!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: Times like this are when I want you to lean on me more.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I am not alone in my
efforts.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Besides, plans only improve each time
we address
their weak points!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash lifts her chin up, ready to
face the
world head-on.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You are absolutely correct... There's no
use in
wallowing in despair and letting
myself spiral.
choice_data_list: If you keep on running, I'm sure you'll find the answer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Continuing to run is the only way to
improve.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, Trainer. Your
blunt honesty
has opened my eyes.
